summary: HR Manager with 10+ years of progressive experience in employee relations, total rewards, and labor compliance across growing mid-market organizations. Skilled at aligning people strategy with business goals while keeping management and staff connected through clear, legally sound policy.

experience.title: Senior HR Manager
experience.employer: a growing mid-market healthcare services company
bullets: Lead a team of 4 HR generalists supporting 600+ employees across three sites, directing employment, compensation, labor relations, and employee relations activities.
Advise managers on equal employment opportunity, harassment prevention, and disciplinary procedures, reducing escalated grievances by 28% year over year.
Redesign compensation and benefits programs after market benchmarking, keeping total rewards competitive while maintaining legal compliance.
Negotiate and interpret two collective bargaining agreements covering 180 hourly staff and represent the organization at personnel-related hearings.
Partner with leadership on workforce planning to address chronic understaffing in clinical support roles, cutting time-to-fill by 22%.

experience.title: HR Manager
bullets: Managed day-to-day HR operations for 350 employees, handling questions, contract interpretation, and work-related problem resolution as the link between management and staff.
Planned and conducted new employee orientation and onboarding, improving 90-day retention by 15%.
Administered difficult staffing duties including dispute mediation, disciplinary actions, and terminations in coordination with legal counsel.
Analyzed and modified benefits policies to establish competitive programs while ensuring compliance with federal and state requirements.
Supervised two HR coordinators and coordinated employment, compensation, and employee relations workflows.

experience.title: HR Generalist
bullets: Served as first point of contact for employee questions on policies, contracts, and workplace concerns, resolving 85% at the manager level.
Supported labor relations activities including grievance documentation and preparation for personnel-related investigations.
Advised supervisors on policy matters such as equal employment opportunity and anti-harassment practices, recommending process improvements.
Assisted with compensation analysis and open enrollment, contributing to a 12% increase in benefits participation.

experience.title: HR Assistant
bullets: Maintained personnel records and supported recruiting, orientation, and benefits administration for a 200-person workforce.
Prepared documentation for disciplinary meetings and personnel hearings, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality.
Responded to employee inquiries on compensation, leave, and policy, escalating complex matters to senior HR staff.
